job.title: Senior Software Engineer (.Net)
job.description: Your IT Future, Delivered Senior Software Engineer (.NET) With a global team of 5600 IT professionals, DHL IT Services enables DHL to connect people and keep the global economy running by continuously innovating and creating sustainable digital solutions . We work globally beyond borders and push boundaries across all dimensions of logistics . You can leave your mark shaping the technological backbone of the biggest logistics company in the world. Our offices in Germany, Malaysia, Czech Republic and India have earned #GreatPlaceToWork certification, reflecting our commitment to exceptional employee experiences. Digitalization. Simply delivered. At IT Services, we are passionate about software development. Our Store Solutions team is continuously expanding. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with a focus on mobile app development. In our diverse environment you can always grow depending on your qualification level. We are working in an agile way, heavily focusing on a team approach where the whole team shares the responsibility for the sprint results and drives continuous improvements. We are convinced that teamwork with a shared responsibility is a major key factor for our success. Our teams are product-oriented, with end-to-end responsibility for the whole lifecycle of the product. In addition to actual development, the work includes tasks that are necessary to ensure continuous support of the software product after rollout in production. At DHL, we use agile frameworks, perform daily scrum meetings, reviews every other week, and regular retrospectives to provide guidance for the team and foster continuous improvement processes. Grow together Our mission in Store Solutions is “We strive for a business-partner-centric and product-centric organization, that lives E2E responsibility by maximizing team empowerment”. In our division, we provide a competitive advantage for the group by collecting and processing data from around 35.000 connected devices from all DHL retail stores across Germany. To enable the DHL retail stores to provide postal services and sell products, we create and maintain different software products ranging from stationary cashbox systems to mobile solutions. As our work has a direct impact on the end-customer experience in DHL retail stores, the high quality of our products means everything to us. Like our company, our teams are global. We have technical teams located in Chennai, Hyderabad, Prague, Darmstadt and Bonn, each with their individual mix of people coming from different nations and working together in a hybrid work model. To help us collaborate better, we use tools like Teams, Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps or Miro. Most importantly, we are a team that supports each other, even in tough times, with every member striving to make things better every day. Ready to embark on the journey? Here’s what we are looking for: We plan to set up new teams to further strengthen our India division. Together with your team you will take part in the development of a multi-platform application to sell products and postal services in the DHL retail stores. Our current application runs on Windows (.NET Core with .NET MAUI / .NET Framework). We are striving to create one multi-platform application that operates on both Android mobile devices and Windows desktop devices We are looking for experienced developers with very good technical skills and strong knowledge in software engineering who help us to add new services to the existing application. Typically, your day would include: Understanding the business requirements Creating design and architecture guidelines Developing the multi-platform application in a collaborative way, together with your team Creating unit tests / automated system tests (TDD) Supporting your team by sharing knowledge Driving continuous improvement of the daily work in your team Collaborate with the team through pull requests review processes The project is part of a roadmap initiative with the aim to migrate a Windows-based fat client solution to a new multiplatform service-based application. This includes the future use of cloud-based technology. You will be part of the team responsible for implementing new services in our .NET MAUI application. As we are currently developing the technical base of our application in parallel, a high degree of adaptability is required for your daily work. An array of benefits for you: Hybrid work arrangements to balance in-office collaboration and home flexibility. Annual Leave: 42 days off apart from Public / National Holidays. Medical Insurance: Self + Spouse + 2 children. An option to opt for Voluntary Parental Insurance (Parents / Parent -in-laws) at a nominal premium covering pre existing disease. In House training programs: professional and technical training certifications
